name: ModelVariant780_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant780_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (the opposing slot is held still while a glow grows at a model part and spins a fan of rays, bands of Gouraud rings climb around the held slot, then a tiled disc and a rising cylinder flare under it and sparks drift upwards while the ambient light dims and recovers); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request and packs three texture images, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 before the start time, 4 between the release and end times, 1 once after the end time, 2 once the effect has finished and 0 otherwise; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-797 and 894 images build it from the same source. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
